_comment: Stasification (the Stasis server's gameplay rules, rewritten for Jondo; Managers/Stasis.cs reads this). Every piece of equipment that drops comes at its max roll times its tier's multiplier: S1 x1.25, S2 x1.5, S3 x2, S4 x3. AP, MP, range, critical, summons, every resistance (the ids in neverMultiplied), maluses, weapon damage and text lines are never multiplied. A normal character's drops are all S1; an evolved one's follow evolvedDropWeights (percent). S3 and S4 can be looted, banked, traded and sold by anyone but only worn by an evolved character. Fusion: 3 identical pieces (template and tier) make 1 of the next tier at its max roll, for fusionCostPerLevel x item level x fusionCostTierFactor[target tier] kamas (kamas stand for Stasis Orbs), never less than fusionCostMinimum; exos are wiped by the S2->S3 fusion only. marketPriceFactor is what a tier is worth against the reference price of the plain item: S1 is its multiplier (1.25) and each next tier three of the one below (3.75, 11, 33), since that is what fusing it costs. The raffineur buys a piece back for raffineurPercent[tier] of that worth -- well below the marketplace, so selling there stays the better road and the raffineur is the outlet for surplus. marketTierWeights is how the market maker's equipment lots are spread among the tiers. craftedTier: the tier a crafted piece is labelled with; its rolled lines (not its max) are multiplied, so crafting keeps its randomness and smithmagic its point.
